profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Cox Automotive Inc
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Cox Automotive, I have experience in full software development lifecycle including analyzing, designing, developing, testing and maintaining scalable new and existing applications. I have over seven years of experience in software engineering, with a focus on developing applications in micro-service architecture including full-stack development.

I enjoy working with a diverse and collaborative team of engineers, designers, and product managers, and I contribute to the continuous improvement of our code quality, performance, and user experience. I am passionate about learning new technologies and best practices. My ultimate goal is to create innovative solutions that truly empower our customers, making a meaningful and lasting impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Team owns and develops a range of internal and external tools to collect precise vehicle information.
- Spearheaded a migration of the legacy system from a desktop-based application to a cloud-hosted web application, resulting in a 40% increase in user productivity by leveraging an advanced, scalable and efficient microservices architecture.
- Worked with development and testing teams to design and develop complex web applications using Java and React, meeting client requirements for functionality, scalability and performance.
- Developed and maintained robust micro services APIs in event driven architecture by leveraging the Java Spring Boot.
- Designed, coded, tested and deployed new features and functionality using CI/CD best practices.
- Obtained business and functional requirements from Product owners and UI/UX designers, and adeptly translated them into resilient, scalable, and maintainable technical solutions. 
- Decreased the amount of support tickets by almost 50% through improved user visibility in the background processes in the Android app by implementing relevant messaging and action history features.
- Implemented automation testing within the pipeline using Docker to improve code quality, and reduced production issues by minimizing bug introductions.
- Developed a Java library for cross-project reuse, thereby minimizing duplicate efforts.
- Applied knowledge of React and programmed in Java using IntelliJ IDE. Employed Splunk for debugging and log analysis, utilized Datadog and New Relic for monitoring, and leveraged Jenkins and Github Actions for deployment pipelines. Additionally, I used Wiremock for automating testing through external API mocking.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Automated invoice procurement using Java and Selenium, resulting in 100% elimination of manual effort in the invoice procurement process.
- I participated in the entire development lifecycle of web applications, starting from requirements gathering and extending through to deployment.
- Established and maintained integration with Asentinel's TEM application and collaborated with cross-functional teams to diagnose and resolve production issues.
